# Quotation response -- KR-RFQ-2026-11

Visakoivu Oy -- technical maintenance services, Ryhtila production and office facility

## Eligibility

2.3 Visakoivu has more than three comparable reference projects within the last five years, including maintenance frameworks for private industrial and logistics clients.

2.4 Valid Urakkavarmenne Varmennettu Toimittaja certificate held.

## Technical response

3.1 Environmental impacts (waste, emissions, noise) arising from maintenance and repair work are managed under our NMSB 74210:2015 environmental management system.

3.2 Scheduled HVAC maintenance follows a fixed annual calendar, with visits logged on completion and confirmed to the Buyer's facilities contact.

3.3 Building envelope condition (roofing, cladding, fabric) is assessed periodically as part of the wider maintenance scope.

3.5 A warranty period is offered on equipment and materials installed under the agreement, stated in the pricing schedule.

3.6 Site-access and security procedures are observed by all personnel working within the active production facility.

3.7 Periodic statutory inspection of electrical installations is programmed across the facility on the applicable cycle.

3.8 Scheduled maintenance visits follow a defined content and frequency, confirmed with the Buyer's facilities contact at contract start.

3.9 The existing asset register and technical documentation will be received from the Buyer, verified against site condition, and kept current throughout.

3.10 Commissioning and testing follow a written protocol after any equipment replacement, with results recorded and shared with the Buyer.

3.11 A method statement is provided for installation work, scheduled to avoid disrupting production wherever practicable.

3.12 Unresolved faults escalate to a named supervisor, then to management, backed by a 24/7 nationwide emergency-response network beyond our Keski-Suomi service area.

3.13 Fire protection systems are tested and maintained on a defined schedule.

3.14 Continuity is maintained through cross-trained cover if key personnel change.

3.15 Condition-monitoring data is collected and reported to the Buyer's facilities contact.

3.16 Common spare parts are held in stock, with stated lead times for less common items.

## Commercial terms

4.1 A retention percentage, where applicable, is stated in the pricing schedule.

4.2 The payment terms set out in this request and its annexes are accepted.

4.3 Invoicing is monthly and available electronically.

4.4 Subcontractor costs, where used, are itemised for transparency on request.

4.5 Pricing distinguishes fixed-price visits, unit-priced parts, and time-based call-out charging.

4.7 A cost breakdown supporting the headline price is enclosed.

## Forms enclosed

CVs of key personnel proposed for the contract.

## Format

6.1 The quotation does not exceed 20 pages, excluding attachments.

6.2 Prices are quoted in EUR per square metre per year, not per month.

6.5 The quotation is submitted as a single PDF file, without password protection.

6.6 The closing time of 13 October 2026, 14:00 Finnish time, is noted.

## Liite A -- Tekninen erittely

A.1 The office wing's passenger lift is maintained in compliance with applicable lift regulations, with records retained and made available on request.

A.3 Site personnel hold the trade qualifications and site-induction requirements for the production areas, including familiarity with shift-supervisor notice procedures.

A.5 A preventive maintenance plan covers all system categories described in this annex, with inspection intervals set per system type.

## Liite B -- Kaupalliset ehdot

B.2 No advance payment is requested under this proposal.

B.3 Minimum font size used throughout, including commercial schedules, is 11pt.

Visakoivu Oy
